chapters.title: Live Sale: record every sale as it happens
chapters.text: This is Live Sale. Every sale in the shop is recorded here, the moment it happens. Each item has its own card.

chapters.title: Find the item
chapters.text: First, find the item. Type its name in Search, and the cards narrow down. You can also use All and Groups.

chapters.title: Check the quantity and the price
chapters.text: Check the quantity and the price on the card. Change them if the customer bought more than one, or agreed a different price.

chapters.title: Who is it for?
chapters.text: Next, say who the sale is for. Type the customer's GM number, phone number or name. If you don't know them, type a short label, such as man in blue shirt.

chapters.title: Tap the red tick to record the sale
chapters.text: Then tap the red tick to record the sale. It goes straight into the Sales Log.

chapters.title: New phone number: the customer form opens
chapters.text: If you type a phone number we do not know, the customer form opens, so you can register them as you sell.

chapters.title: Several items, one customer: MI
chapters.text: When one customer buys several items, tap MI. Add each item to the basket, pick the customer, and issue one receipt for everything.

chapters.title: WIC is a sale, GMC is shop use
chapters.text: Keep the switch on WIC for a sale to a customer. GMC is only for things the shop uses itself, and it is not a sale.

chapters.title: Wrong sale? Undo it in the Sales Log
chapters.text: If you record a sale by mistake, undo it in the Sales Log. Never tap again to correct it, because that records a second sale.
